needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Analyze revenue streams, customer behavior, transaction data, and product usage trends to identify business opportunities and support revenue growth. Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards, reports, and performance scorecards to monitor key revenue and business metrics. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability through regular audits, validation, and data-cleaning activities. Conduct ad-hoc analyses to support business decisions, revenue forecasting, and strategic planning. Identify opportunities to automate revenue tracking workflows and improve operational processes. Evaluate CRM functionality, particularly Salesforce, and recommend improvements to enhance reporting capabilities and data management. Document revenue-related processes and contribute to better data alignment across systems and departments. Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to translate business needs into actionable data insights. Provide support to internal users on CRM reporting, troubleshooting, and data-related questions. Promote data best practices and support colleagues through training on reporting tools and processes. Requirements: At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, revenue analytics, business intelligence, or CRM optimization. Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and business intelligence or data platforms such as Metabase, Snowflake, or similar tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive, detail-oriented mindset, with the ability to independently identify, investigate, and resolve data-related issues. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Spanish proficiency at an advanced level (C1/C2). Experience in digital marketplaces or B2B e-commerce, particularly inventory management, pricing, and price list management, is an advantage. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and automation solutions for improving data analysis or revenue operations is a plus. Experience in commercial strategy or operations, with demonstrable contributions to revenue growth, is desirable. Benefits: Competitive and negotiable compensation based on experience and qualifications. Fully remote working environment, offering flexibility to work from different locations. Independent and versatile role with opportunities to take ownership of projects and make meaningful contributions. Opportunity to work within a fast-growing, international organization alongside diverse teams across the Americas and Europe. Autonomy and an ownership-driven culture that encourages initiative and individual contributions. Commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and career growth. needs_verification.title: Fast Track Operations Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities: Provide personalized, one-to-one onboarding support to customers enrolled in Fast Track packages, ensuring a smooth and efficient implementation experience. Guide customers through A2P number onboarding processes and help resolve existing onboarding challenges based on their specific requirements. Provide compliance guidance across A2P products, ensuring customers understand applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements. Manage onboarding service-level agreements (SLAs), monitor timelines, and oversee credit utilization across assigned products. Coordinate with internal operations teams to scale onboarding volumes and support the successful implementation of customer requirements. Manage a portfolio of up to 12 customer accounts, overseeing daily workloads, priorities, and outstanding onboarding activities. Participate in weekly customer meetings to present performance metrics, review open issues, discuss progress, and identify additional onboarding needs. Respond to customer inquiries through communication channels such as Slack and ServiceNow, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused assistance. Assess product and service-related issues, troubleshoot basic problems, and coordinate with the appropriate teams when more advanced technical support is required. Record customer interactions accurately and categorize issues appropriately to support efficient tracking, reporting, and resolution. Monitor recurring challenges and operational trends, communicating relevant findings and recommendations to product teams to support continuous improvement. Partner with account management teams to proactively address customer concerns and communicate industry or regulatory changes that may affect onboarding experiences. Prioritize competing requests, maintain accurate records, and ensure all assigned tasks and customer commitments are completed within established SLAs. Requirements: At least 2 years of professional experience specializing in one or more Application-to-Person (A2P) messaging products. Previous experience working directly with customers, preferably in onboarding, implementation, operations, or customer success roles within a technology or telecommunications environment. Practical knowledge of A2P compliance requirements and the ability to provide appropriate guidance throughout customer onboarding processes. Ability to manage daily caseloads, handle multiple customer accounts, and consistently deliver responses and resolutions within defined SLAs. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and oversee several onboarding activities simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer relationships and take ownership of up to 12 assigned accounts. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to lead customer meetings, present performance metrics, and explain complex processes clearly. Strong customer service orientation, empathy, and a proactive approach to understanding and addressing customer needs. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams. Adaptability, accountability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional improvement. Availability to work the NAMER shift, Monday–Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM Indian Standard Time (IST). Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gemini, is preferred. Experience with reporting and performance monitoring tools is an advantage. Previous experience implementing different types of A2P phone numbers is desirable. Understanding of general CTIA guidelines and international telecommunications regulatory requirements is preferred. Experience leading customer calls, managing multiple priorities, and working within strict service-level agreements is an additional advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote opportunity based in India, with location eligibility covering Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Delhi. Flexible Work Culture: Remote-first environment designed to support collaboration across geographically distributed teams. Competitive Compensation: Competitive pay based on the role, experience, and location. Paid Time Off: Generous time-off allowances to support work-life balance. Parental Leave: Access to parental leave benefits. Wellness Support: Dedicated wellness leave and resources to support employee well-being. Healthcare Coverage: Healthcare benefits, with provisions varying according to location. Retirement Savings: Access to a retirement savings program, subject to local eligibility. Professional Development: Opportunity to gain experience in A2P messaging, telecommunications compliance, customer onboarding, and global operations. Industry Exposure: Work at the intersection of communications technology, customer experience, and large-scale digital messaging solutions. Team Engagement: Occasional travel may be required for in-person team gatherings, customer meetings, or functional events. needs_verification.title: Middle Customer Support Operations Specialist
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: You will manage day-to-day customer support operations while developing scalable processes that improve efficiency, service quality, and customer satisfaction. Your responsibilities will include: Manage customer support requests across multiple digital products. Handle subscription cancellations, refund requests, and payment-related inquiries. Set up and maintain customer support systems, including response templates, communication workflows, and automated processes. Develop, implement, and optimize support procedures for both new and existing products. Monitor support quality, response times, and ticket resolution to maintain high service standards. Analyze customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and communicate relevant insights to product teams. Collaborate with product managers and developers to investigate and resolve customer issues. Maintain internal documentation, support guidelines, and knowledge bases. Manage operational tasks within the R&D department and identify opportunities to improve internal workflows. Requirements: The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in customer support or operations, preferably within B2C digital products or subscription-based businesses. You should be comfortable managing customer requests, improving support processes, and working with different teams and digital tools. Strong written communication, analytical thinking, and organizational skills are essential. At least 2 years of experience in Customer Support or Operations, preferably in B2C digital products. Experience handling customer inquiries, subscription cancellations, refunds, and payment-related issues. Understanding of subscription-based business models and payment systems. Familiarity with CRM and helpdesk platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk, or similar tools. Ability to create and manage response templates, support workflows, and automated customer communications. English proficiency at B2 level or above, with strong written communication skills. Proficiency in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel. Nice to have: Experience working with mobile applications and subscription-based products. needs_verification.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
needs_verification.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to own marketing reporting, manage HubSpot processes, and build automation and AI-powered workflows. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Operations Manager and support demand gen, content, events, sales and RevOps with reporting, campaign operations and lead management. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards tracking data health, issue aging, recurrence, monitoring coverage, and remediation performance. Identify opportunities to prevent recurring defects by improving upstream controls, pipelines, data contracts, source processes, documentation, and operating procedures. Contribute to data product certification, maturity assessments, metadata management, lineage validation, governance standards, stewardship workflows, and technical runbooks. Familiarity with data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, or data observability platforms. Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms. Knowledge of Collibra Data Quality & Observability and the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform. Familiarity with tools such as dbt, Informatica, Monte Carlo, Soda, Great Expectations, or comparable data quality and observability solutions. Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data catalogs, and data product certification. needs_verification.title: CLM Associate
needs_verification.description: Accountabilities:: Campaign Planning and Execution Plan and execute weekly CLM campaign calendars across push notifications, in-app messages, email, and SMS, aligned with product events, promotional activities, and engagement initiatives. Build, launch, and manage end-to-end campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Configure campaign audiences, creatives, scheduling, frequency caps, quiet hours, and channel-specific delivery settings. Maintain campaign execution standards, including naming conventions, UTM tracking, approval workflows, and quality assurance checks. Validate campaign links, audience segments, messaging content, and scheduling to ensure accuracy before deployment. Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to ensure timely and consistent campaign execution. Customer Journeys and Segmentation Build, manage, and optimise automated customer lifecycle journeys covering onboarding, first-game participation, first-deposit conversion, repeat engagement, churn prevention, and user reactivation. Develop and maintain audience segments using behavioural and transactional indicators, including user recency, deposit tiers, game preferences, engagement levels, and lifecycle stages. Configure automated journey logic using triggers, time delays, conditional branches, and exit criteria. Coordinate personalised communications for VIP and high-value customers in collaboration with relevant business and LiveOps teams. Ensure communications are relevant, timely, and personalised while minimising excessive messaging and notification fatigue. Experimentation and Optimisation Plan and execute structured A/B tests across campaign copy, creatives, delivery timing, communication channels, and promotional incentives. Apply disciplined testing methodologies by changing one variable at a time and maintaining control or holdout groups wherever applicable. Evaluate campaign effectiveness using key business metrics, including First-Time Deposits (FTD), deposits, Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), user reactivation, and retention. Maintain a campaign learnings repository documenting successful experiments, underperforming campaigns, and actionable insights. Identify opportunities to improve campaign engagement, conversion, and customer retention. Reporting and Performance Analysis Own weekly CLM performance reporting, covering campaign results, customer journey performance, holdout analysis, and execution-related incidents. Monitor campaign health indicators, including deliverability, opt-out rates, notification engagement, and communication fatigue. Identify performance trends and potential engagement issues, recommending corrective actions before they negatively affect retention or revenue. Share customer behaviour insights and campaign learnings with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to support business and product decisions. Track campaign performance against defined business objectives and communicate results accurately. Requirements: 1–3 years of professional experience in CRM Marketing, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention Marketing, or Customer Engagement. Hands-on experience planning, building, executing, and monitoring campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Proven ability to manage high-volume campaigns with strong execution discipline and minimal errors in audience targeting, scheduling, content, and delivery. Working knowledge of customer segmentation and automated journey-building concepts, including triggers, waiting periods, conditional branches, and exit conditions. Good understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, user activation, engagement, retention, churn prevention, and reactivation strategies. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret conversion funnels, campaign metrics, customer behaviour, and holdout results to evaluate campaign performance. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for campaign tracking, reporting, and performance analysis. Basic SQL knowledge is a strong advantage. Strong copywriting and communication skills, particularly the ability to create concise, engaging, and conversion-focused push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and SMS campaigns. Excellent attention to detail, organisational abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously. A proactive, accountable, and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to identify issues early and continuously improve campaign performance. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Good to have: Experience in the gaming, Real Money Gaming (RMG), fintech, or high-frequency consumer application industries. Exposure to international markets, particularly the United States or Brazil, including timezone-sensitive campaign scheduling. Experience coordinating Portuguese-language campaigns. Familiarity with communication deliverability and technical health, including push notification token health, email sender reputation, and SMS delivery routes. Experience coordinating with promotional, offers, or rewards teams where customer communications involve monetary incentives. Working knowledge of SQL for advanced audience analysis, segmentation, and campaign performance reporting. Key competencies: Detail-oriented: Maintains accuracy across campaign content, audience selection, scheduling, and execution. Execution-focused: Comfortable planning, building, testing, and launching campaigns regularly while following established quality checks. Data-driven: Uses customer behaviour, campaign metrics, and performance trends to identify opportunities and improve results. Customer-centric: Understands user preferences and communication fatigue, ensuring messages are relevant, personalised, and appropriately timed. Proactive and accountable: Takes ownership of campaign outcomes, identifies potential issues early, and continuously seeks improvements. Collaborative: Works effectively across teams to align customer communications with product and business priorities. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Annual salary ranging from INR 5 LPA to INR 10 LPA (₹500,000–₹1,000,000). Fully remote work: Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in India. Full-time opportunity: Stable, full-time professional engagement. Career development: Opportunity to grow from hands-on campaign execution into broader lifecycle marketing strategy and ownership. Practical CRM experience: Work with leading customer engagement and marketing automation platforms, including MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, and WebEngage. Cross-functional exposure: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Measurable business impact: Directly contribute to customer activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and reactivation. Professional growth: Develop expertise in CRM operations, customer segmentation, lifecycle automation, experimentation, and data-driven marketing. How Jobgether works: We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. #LI-CL1

review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Analyze revenue streams, customer behavior, transaction data, and product usage trends to identify business opportunities and support revenue growth. Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards, reports, and performance scorecards to monitor key revenue and business metrics. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability through regular audits, validation, and data-cleaning activities. Conduct ad-hoc analyses to support business decisions, revenue forecasting, and strategic planning. Identify opportunities to automate revenue tracking workflows and improve operational processes. Evaluate CRM functionality, particularly Salesforce, and recommend improvements to enhance reporting capabilities and data management. Document revenue-related processes and contribute to better data alignment across systems and departments. Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to translate business needs into actionable data insights. Provide support to internal users on CRM reporting, troubleshooting, and data-related questions. Promote data best practices and support colleagues through training on reporting tools and processes. Requirements: At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, revenue analytics, business intelligence, or CRM optimization. Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets. Hands-on experience with Salesforce and business intelligence or data platforms such as Metabase, Snowflake, or similar tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable recommendations. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A proactive, detail-oriented mindset, with the ability to independently identify, investigate, and resolve data-related issues. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines. Fluency in English, both written and spoken. Spanish proficiency at an advanced level (C1/C2). Experience in digital marketplaces or B2B e-commerce, particularly inventory management, pricing, and price list management, is an advantage. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and automation solutions for improving data analysis or revenue operations is a plus. Experience in commercial strategy or operations, with demonstrable contributions to revenue growth, is desirable. Benefits: Competitive and negotiable compensation based on experience and qualifications. Fully remote working environment, offering flexibility to work from different locations. Independent and versatile role with opportunities to take ownership of projects and make meaningful contributions. Opportunity to work within a fast-growing, international organization alongside diverse teams across the Americas and Europe. Autonomy and an ownership-driven culture that encourages initiative and individual contributions. Commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and career growth. Financial support for technical certifications and other learning opportunities. Exposure to international business operations, revenue strategy, and evolving technology platforms. review_queue.title: Fast Track Operations Specialist
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Provide personalized, one-to-one onboarding support to customers enrolled in Fast Track packages, ensuring a smooth and efficient implementation experience. Guide customers through A2P number onboarding processes and help resolve existing onboarding challenges based on their specific requirements. Provide compliance guidance across A2P products, ensuring customers understand applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements. Manage onboarding service-level agreements (SLAs), monitor timelines, and oversee credit utilization across assigned products. Coordinate with internal operations teams to scale onboarding volumes and support the successful implementation of customer requirements. Manage a portfolio of up to 12 customer accounts, overseeing daily workloads, priorities, and outstanding onboarding activities. Participate in weekly customer meetings to present performance metrics, review open issues, discuss progress, and identify additional onboarding needs. Respond to customer inquiries through communication channels such as Slack and ServiceNow, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused assistance. Assess product and service-related issues, troubleshoot basic problems, and coordinate with the appropriate teams when more advanced technical support is required. Record customer interactions accurately and categorize issues appropriately to support efficient tracking, reporting, and resolution. Monitor recurring challenges and operational trends, communicating relevant findings and recommendations to product teams to support continuous improvement. Partner with account management teams to proactively address customer concerns and communicate industry or regulatory changes that may affect onboarding experiences. Prioritize competing requests, maintain accurate records, and ensure all assigned tasks and customer commitments are completed within established SLAs. Requirements: At least 2 years of professional experience specializing in one or more Application-to-Person (A2P) messaging products. Previous experience working directly with customers, preferably in onboarding, implementation, operations, or customer success roles within a technology or telecommunications environment. Practical knowledge of A2P compliance requirements and the ability to provide appropriate guidance throughout customer onboarding processes. Ability to manage daily caseloads, handle multiple customer accounts, and consistently deliver responses and resolutions within defined SLAs. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and oversee several onboarding activities simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer relationships and take ownership of up to 12 assigned accounts. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to lead customer meetings, present performance metrics, and explain complex processes clearly. Strong customer service orientation, empathy, and a proactive approach to understanding and addressing customer needs. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams. Adaptability, accountability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional improvement. Availability to work the NAMER shift, Monday–Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM Indian Standard Time (IST). Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gemini, is preferred. Experience with reporting and performance monitoring tools is an advantage. Previous experience implementing different types of A2P phone numbers is desirable. Understanding of general CTIA guidelines and international telecommunications regulatory requirements is preferred. Experience leading customer calls, managing multiple priorities, and working within strict service-level agreements is an additional advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote opportunity based in India, with location eligibility covering Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Delhi. Flexible Work Culture: Remote-first environment designed to support collaboration across geographically distributed teams. Competitive Compensation: Competitive pay based on the role, experience, and location. Paid Time Off: Generous time-off allowances to support work-life balance. Parental Leave: Access to parental leave benefits. Wellness Support: Dedicated wellness leave and resources to support employee well-being. Healthcare Coverage: Healthcare benefits, with provisions varying according to location. Retirement Savings: Access to a retirement savings program, subject to local eligibility. Professional Development: Opportunity to gain experience in A2P messaging, telecommunications compliance, customer onboarding, and global operations. Industry Exposure: Work at the intersection of communications technology, customer experience, and large-scale digital messaging solutions. Team Engagement: Occasional travel may be required for in-person team gatherings, customer meetings, or functional events. review_queue.title: Project Coordinator - Generative AI Data Operations
review_queue.description: Accountabilities: Coordinate the end-to-end delivery of multiple AI training data projects, including data collection, labeling, annotation, and evaluation activities. Plan project launches, define tasks, assign work batches, monitor progress, and identify operational blockers. Create and maintain project schedules, track dependencies, and manage changes within agreed scope and delivery requirements. Monitor timelines, costs, and quality standards, escalating risks or deviations when project objectives may be affected. Apply project guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs), conduct quality spot checks, coordinate feedback, and manage rework until expected standards are achieved. Support regular client communication by sharing progress updates, highlighting risks, clarifying requirements, and confirming next steps. Coordinate resource planning by forecasting annotator and rater capacity, requesting additional resources, and aligning shifts, handovers, and training needs with internal teams and vendors. Maintain risk and issue logs, perform initial root-cause analysis, implement mitigation actions, and document outcomes. Keep project trackers, dashboards, and documentation up to date, including volumes, throughput, quality metrics, and incidents. Support project administration activities such as purchase order tracking, time-entry processes, and invoice confirmations. Follow operational procedures and security and compliance policies while identifying opportunities to improve delivery speed, quality, and cost efficiency. Use project management and data tools, including spreadsheets, task boards, ticketing systems, and basic business intelligence platforms, while supporting consistent usage across teams. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Data, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 0–2 years of experience in project coordination, project delivery, or operations, ideally within AI data operations, content review, labeling, annotation, or related fields. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple small- to medium-sized projects simultaneously. Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams. review_queue.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
review_queue.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to own marketing reporting, manage HubSpot processes, and build automation and AI-powered workflows. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Operations Manager and support demand gen, content, events, sales and RevOps with reporting, campaign operations and lead management. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

review_queue.title: CLM Associate
review_queue.description: Accountabilities:: Campaign Planning and Execution Plan and execute weekly CLM campaign calendars across push notifications, in-app messages, email, and SMS, aligned with product events, promotional activities, and engagement initiatives. Build, launch, and manage end-to-end campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Configure campaign audiences, creatives, scheduling, frequency caps, quiet hours, and channel-specific delivery settings. Maintain campaign execution standards, including naming conventions, UTM tracking, approval workflows, and quality assurance checks. Validate campaign links, audience segments, messaging content, and scheduling to ensure accuracy before deployment. Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to ensure timely and consistent campaign execution. Customer Journeys and Segmentation Build, manage, and optimise automated customer lifecycle journeys covering onboarding, first-game participation, first-deposit conversion, repeat engagement, churn prevention, and user reactivation. Develop and maintain audience segments using behavioural and transactional indicators, including user recency, deposit tiers, game preferences, engagement levels, and lifecycle stages. Configure automated journey logic using triggers, time delays, conditional branches, and exit criteria. Coordinate personalised communications for VIP and high-value customers in collaboration with relevant business and LiveOps teams. Ensure communications are relevant, timely, and personalised while minimising excessive messaging and notification fatigue. Experimentation and Optimisation Plan and execute structured A/B tests across campaign copy, creatives, delivery timing, communication channels, and promotional incentives. Apply disciplined testing methodologies by changing one variable at a time and maintaining control or holdout groups wherever applicable. Evaluate campaign effectiveness using key business metrics, including First-Time Deposits (FTD), deposits, Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), user reactivation, and retention. Maintain a campaign learnings repository documenting successful experiments, underperforming campaigns, and actionable insights. Identify opportunities to improve campaign engagement, conversion, and customer retention. Reporting and Performance Analysis Own weekly CLM performance reporting, covering campaign results, customer journey performance, holdout analysis, and execution-related incidents. Monitor campaign health indicators, including deliverability, opt-out rates, notification engagement, and communication fatigue. Identify performance trends and potential engagement issues, recommending corrective actions before they negatively affect retention or revenue. Share customer behaviour insights and campaign learnings with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to support business and product decisions. Track campaign performance against defined business objectives and communicate results accurately. Requirements: 1–3 years of professional experience in CRM Marketing, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention Marketing, or Customer Engagement. Hands-on experience planning, building, executing, and monitoring campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Proven ability to manage high-volume campaigns with strong execution discipline and minimal errors in audience targeting, scheduling, content, and delivery. Working knowledge of customer segmentation and automated journey-building concepts, including triggers, waiting periods, conditional branches, and exit conditions. Good understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, user activation, engagement, retention, churn prevention, and reactivation strategies. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret conversion funnels, campaign metrics, customer behaviour, and holdout results to evaluate campaign performance. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for campaign tracking, reporting, and performance analysis. Basic SQL knowledge is a strong advantage. Strong copywriting and communication skills, particularly the ability to create concise, engaging, and conversion-focused push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and SMS campaigns. Excellent attention to detail, organisational abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously. A proactive, accountable, and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to identify issues early and continuously improve campaign performance. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Good to have: Experience in the gaming, Real Money Gaming (RMG), fintech, or high-frequency consumer application industries. human_review.title: Senior Marketing Operations Specialist
human_review.description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. Life as a Sprinter - Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. The mission - We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Operations Specialist to own marketing reporting, manage HubSpot processes, and build automation and AI-powered workflows. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Operations Manager and support demand gen, content, events, sales and RevOps with reporting, campaign operations and lead management. Where you'll leave your mark?: Own reporting across leads, demos, pipeline and revenue by channel and campaign. Build dashboards in HubSpot and BI tools, investigate performance changes and recommend next steps. Improve ROI and attribution reporting, with consistent metric definitions across marketing and RevOps. Manage HubSpot properties, lists, lifecycle stages and data quality. Maintain lead scoring, routing and handoff workflows in partnership with sales and RevOps. Maintain tracking across forms, UTMs, GA4 and HubSpot, and support campaign setup and launches. Automate manual processes using HubSpot workflows and tools like Zapier, n8n or Make. Build AI-powered workflows for lead research, enrichment, data cleanup and reporting. Test and monitor workflows, measure their impact and document how they work. The kind of builder we're looking for -: 3+ years in marketing or revenue operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. Strong hands-on HubSpot experience and experience independently managing operational projects. Confidence analysing data in Excel or Google Sheets and building dashboards in a BI tool. A solid understanding of the B2B funnel, conversion rates and marketing-to-sales handoffs. Experience building automations and at least one practical AI-powered workflow, at work or in a side project. Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills and clear communication. Good to Have Basic SQL and familiarity with APIs, webhooks and JSON. Experience with GA4, enrichment or intent tools. Experience evaluating, rolling out and managing a MarTech or GTM tool. How we care for our Sprinters? Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach. Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance. We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills. We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to. Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary. Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you. Inclusion & Diversity - At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Coordinate the end-to-end delivery of multiple AI training data projects, including data collection, labeling, annotation, and evaluation activities. Plan project launches, define tasks, assign work batches, monitor progress, and identify operational blockers. Create and maintain project schedules, track dependencies, and manage changes within agreed scope and delivery requirements. Monitor timelines, costs, and quality standards, escalating risks or deviations when project objectives may be affected. Apply project guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs), conduct quality spot checks, coordinate feedback, and manage rework until expected standards are achieved. Support regular client communication by sharing progress updates, highlighting risks, clarifying requirements, and confirming next steps. Coordinate resource planning by forecasting annotator and rater capacity, requesting additional resources, and aligning shifts, handovers, and training needs with internal teams and vendors. Maintain risk and issue logs, perform initial root-cause analysis, implement mitigation actions, and document outcomes. Keep project trackers, dashboards, and documentation up to date, including volumes, throughput, quality metrics, and incidents. Support project administration activities such as purchase order tracking, time-entry processes, and invoice confirmations. Follow operational procedures and security and compliance policies while identifying opportunities to improve delivery speed, quality, and cost efficiency. Use project management and data tools, including spreadsheets, task boards, ticketing systems, and basic business intelligence platforms, while supporting consistent usage across teams. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Data, Operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 0–2 years of experience in project coordination, project delivery, or operations, ideally within AI data operations, content review, labeling, annotation, or related fields. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple small- to medium-sized projects simultaneously. Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to coordinate effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams. Familiarity with spreadsheets, project management tools, task boards, and basic business intelligence platforms. Basic knowledge of ETL processes or SQL is an advantage. Ability to consistently follow SOPs, perform quality checks, and maintain accurate project documentation, change records, and risk logs. Good problem-solving skills and the ability to identify delivery issues, perform initial root-cause checks, and escalate exceptions appropriately. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while seeking guidance when decisions fall outside established processes. Sound judgment when making routine delivery decisions within defined scope, cost, and quality requirements. Adaptability, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to improving operational processes. Benefits: Full-time employment. Remote working arrangement, with the role listed for Asia and Gurgaon. Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in Generative AI training and evaluation operations. Exposure to project coordination across data collection, labeling, annotation, and quality management. verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: As a Fast Track Operations Specialist, you will oversee personalized customer onboarding activities, resolve operational challenges, and coordinate with internal teams to deliver timely, compliant, and effective solutions. Your responsibilities will include: Provide tailored onboarding support to customers enrolled in Fast Track packages, including assistance with A2P number onboarding. Identify and resolve existing onboarding issues through proactive customer engagement. Provide compliance guidance across A2P products and help customers understand applicable requirements. Monitor onboarding SLAs and credit utilization across assigned products. Manage daily customer caseloads and coordinate with operations teams to scale onboarding volumes. Own relationships with up to 12 customer accounts, ensuring their onboarding needs are addressed effectively. Participate in weekly customer calls to review performance metrics, discuss outstanding items, and identify additional onboarding requirements. Respond to customer inquiries through Slack and ServiceNow, ensuring consistent and high-quality support. Assess product and service issues, troubleshoot basic problems, and escalate more complex cases when necessary. Record customer interactions and accurately categorize support issues. Identify recurring trends and communicate findings to product teams to support issue resolution and product improvements. Collaborate with account teams to proactively address customer concerns and communicate industry or regulatory changes that may affect onboarding. Requirements: The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in A2P products and customer-facing operations, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize competing demands, and deliver reliable support within defined SLAs. Strong communication skills, sound judgment, and a proactive, customer-centric approach are essential. At least 2 years of experience specializing in one or more A2P products. Previous experience working directly with customers or clients. Practical experience with A2P compliance requirements. Ability to manage daily caseloads, meet service-level commitments, and respond within established SLAs. Availability to work the NAMER shift, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST. Strong prioritization, multitasking, and project management skills. Ability to independently manage and take ownership of up to 12 customer accounts. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A highly empathetic, customer-focused mindset and commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Desired qualifications: Familiarity with Google Workspace tools, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gemini. Experience using reporting tools and analyzing operational metrics. Confidence leading customer calls and coordinating discussions. Experience managing operational workflows against defined SLAs. Benefits: Competitive compensation. Generous paid time off. Opportunities to participate in occasional in-person team or project meetings. Support for employee volunteering and charitable donation initiatives. verification_backlog.title: Fast Track Operations Specialist
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Provide personalized, one-to-one onboarding support to customers enrolled in Fast Track packages, ensuring a smooth and efficient implementation experience. Guide customers through A2P number onboarding processes and help resolve existing onboarding challenges based on their specific requirements. Provide compliance guidance across A2P products, ensuring customers understand applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements. Manage onboarding service-level agreements (SLAs), monitor timelines, and oversee credit utilization across assigned products. Coordinate with internal operations teams to scale onboarding volumes and support the successful implementation of customer requirements. Manage a portfolio of up to 12 customer accounts, overseeing daily workloads, priorities, and outstanding onboarding activities. Participate in weekly customer meetings to present performance metrics, review open issues, discuss progress, and identify additional onboarding needs. Respond to customer inquiries through communication channels such as Slack and ServiceNow, delivering timely, accurate, and customer-focused assistance. Assess product and service-related issues, troubleshoot basic problems, and coordinate with the appropriate teams when more advanced technical support is required. Record customer interactions accurately and categorize issues appropriately to support efficient tracking, reporting, and resolution. Monitor recurring challenges and operational trends, communicating relevant findings and recommendations to product teams to support continuous improvement. Partner with account management teams to proactively address customer concerns and communicate industry or regulatory changes that may affect onboarding experiences. Prioritize competing requests, maintain accurate records, and ensure all assigned tasks and customer commitments are completed within established SLAs. Requirements: At least 2 years of professional experience specializing in one or more Application-to-Person (A2P) messaging products. Previous experience working directly with customers, preferably in onboarding, implementation, operations, or customer success roles within a technology or telecommunications environment. Practical knowledge of A2P compliance requirements and the ability to provide appropriate guidance throughout customer onboarding processes. Ability to manage daily caseloads, handle multiple customer accounts, and consistently deliver responses and resolutions within defined SLAs. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and oversee several onboarding activities simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to independently manage customer relationships and take ownership of up to 12 assigned accounts. Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the confidence to lead customer meetings, present performance metrics, and explain complex processes clearly. Strong customer service orientation, empathy, and a proactive approach to understanding and addressing customer needs. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams. Adaptability, accountability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional improvement. Availability to work the NAMER shift, Monday–Friday, from 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM Indian Standard Time (IST). Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Gemini, is preferred. Experience with reporting and performance monitoring tools is an advantage. Previous experience implementing different types of A2P phone numbers is desirable. Understanding of general CTIA guidelines and international telecommunications regulatory requirements is preferred. Experience leading customer calls, managing multiple priorities, and working within strict service-level agreements is an additional advantage. Benefits: Remote Work: Fully remote opportunity based in India, with location eligibility covering Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Delhi. Flexible Work Culture: Remote-first environment designed to support collaboration across geographically distributed teams. Competitive Compensation: Competitive pay based on the role, experience, and location. Paid Time Off: Generous time-off allowances to support work-life balance. Parental Leave: Access to parental leave benefits. Wellness Support: Dedicated wellness leave and resources to support employee well-being. Healthcare Coverage: Healthcare benefits, with provisions varying according to location. Retirement Savings: Access to a retirement savings program, subject to local eligibility. Professional Development: Opportunity to gain experience in A2P messaging, telecommunications compliance, customer onboarding, and global operations. Industry Exposure: Work at the intersection of communications technology, customer experience, and large-scale digital messaging solutions. Team Engagement: Occasional travel may be required for in-person team gatherings, customer meetings, or functional events. verification_backlog.title: Data Steward
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities: Monitor data quality and observability across foundational data assets and business-ready data products, reviewing alerts related to completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, freshness, and unexpected data patterns. Prioritize data issues according to business impact, data criticality, downstream usage, and risk, while identifying recurring defects and monitoring gaps. Investigate anomalies and reported defects using SQL, data profiling, metadata, lineage, and observability evidence. Trace issues across source systems, ingestion processes, ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, data platforms, semantic layers, and downstream products to identify root causes. Assess the scope and business impact of data issues, document findings and recommendations, and assign accountability to the appropriate resolution teams. Coordinate remediation with data owners, business stewards, portfolio owners, engineers, platform teams, and system owners; track progress and escalate high-impact or recurring issues when necessary. Validate implemented fixes, confirm closure evidence, and ensure corrective actions do not create unintended downstream impacts. Support the onboarding of data products and critical data elements into enterprise data quality and observability capabilities. Translate business expectations into measurable data quality rules, monitoring thresholds, alerts, and controls, helping reduce false positives. Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards tracking data health, issue aging, recurrence, monitoring coverage, and remediation performance. Identify opportunities to prevent recurring defects by improving upstream controls, pipelines, data contracts, source processes, documentation, and operating procedures. Contribute to data product certification, maturity assessments, metadata management, lineage validation, governance standards, stewardship workflows, and technical runbooks. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in technical data stewardship, data quality, data management, data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related field. Strong SQL skills, including hands-on experience with data profiling, reconciliation, and troubleshooting. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across source systems, data transformations, pipelines, platforms, and downstream consumption layers. Experience defining or implementing data quality rules across dimensions such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness. Familiarity with data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, or data observability platforms. Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms. Knowledge of Collibra Data Quality & Observability and the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform. Familiarity with tools such as dbt, Informatica, Monte Carlo, Soda, Great Expectations, or comparable data quality and observability solutions. Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data catalogs, and data product certification. Familiarity with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, or similar tools for managing investigation and remediation workflows. Ability to translate business expectations into measurable technical controls and communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to coordinate resolution across multiple teams and drive progress without direct authority. Experience supporting data product or federated data governance models and working in complex, global, matrixed organizations is an advantage. Ability to perform the essential functions of the role, including extended computer-based work and occasional movement to attend meetings. Benefits Full-time employment. Remote work arrangement. The role is based in Bengaluru, India. Specific salary, healthcare coverage, insurance, paid leave, and additional benefits are not detailed in the job description. verification_backlog.title: CLM Associate
verification_backlog.description: Accountabilities:: Campaign Planning and Execution Plan and execute weekly CLM campaign calendars across push notifications, in-app messages, email, and SMS, aligned with product events, promotional activities, and engagement initiatives. Build, launch, and manage end-to-end campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Configure campaign audiences, creatives, scheduling, frequency caps, quiet hours, and channel-specific delivery settings. Maintain campaign execution standards, including naming conventions, UTM tracking, approval workflows, and quality assurance checks. Validate campaign links, audience segments, messaging content, and scheduling to ensure accuracy before deployment. Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to ensure timely and consistent campaign execution. Customer Journeys and Segmentation Build, manage, and optimise automated customer lifecycle journeys covering onboarding, first-game participation, first-deposit conversion, repeat engagement, churn prevention, and user reactivation. Develop and maintain audience segments using behavioural and transactional indicators, including user recency, deposit tiers, game preferences, engagement levels, and lifecycle stages. Configure automated journey logic using triggers, time delays, conditional branches, and exit criteria. Coordinate personalised communications for VIP and high-value customers in collaboration with relevant business and LiveOps teams. Ensure communications are relevant, timely, and personalised while minimising excessive messaging and notification fatigue. Experimentation and Optimisation Plan and execute structured A/B tests across campaign copy, creatives, delivery timing, communication channels, and promotional incentives. Apply disciplined testing methodologies by changing one variable at a time and maintaining control or holdout groups wherever applicable. Evaluate campaign effectiveness using key business metrics, including First-Time Deposits (FTD), deposits, Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), user reactivation, and retention. Maintain a campaign learnings repository documenting successful experiments, underperforming campaigns, and actionable insights. Identify opportunities to improve campaign engagement, conversion, and customer retention. Reporting and Performance Analysis Own weekly CLM performance reporting, covering campaign results, customer journey performance, holdout analysis, and execution-related incidents. Monitor campaign health indicators, including deliverability, opt-out rates, notification engagement, and communication fatigue. Identify performance trends and potential engagement issues, recommending corrective actions before they negatively affect retention or revenue. Share customer behaviour insights and campaign learnings with Product, Marketing, and LiveOps teams to support business and product decisions. Track campaign performance against defined business objectives and communicate results accurately. Requirements: 1–3 years of professional experience in CRM Marketing, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention Marketing, or Customer Engagement. Hands-on experience planning, building, executing, and monitoring campaigns using CRM and marketing automation platforms such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, WebEngage, or similar tools. Proven ability to manage high-volume campaigns with strong execution discipline and minimal errors in audience targeting, scheduling, content, and delivery. Working knowledge of customer segmentation and automated journey-building concepts, including triggers, waiting periods, conditional branches, and exit conditions. Good understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, user activation, engagement, retention, churn prevention, and reactivation strategies. Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret conversion funnels, campaign metrics, customer behaviour, and holdout results to evaluate campaign performance. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for campaign tracking, reporting, and performance analysis. Basic SQL knowledge is a strong advantage. Strong copywriting and communication skills, particularly the ability to create concise, engaging, and conversion-focused push notifications, in-app messages, emails, and SMS campaigns. Excellent attention to detail, organisational abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously. A proactive, accountable, and customer-centric mindset, with the ability to identify issues early and continuously improve campaign performance. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Good to have: Experience in the gaming, Real Money Gaming (RMG), fintech, or high-frequency consumer application industries. Exposure to international markets, particularly the United States or Brazil, including timezone-sensitive campaign scheduling. Experience coordinating Portuguese-language campaigns. Familiarity with communication deliverability and technical health, including push notification token health, email sender reputation, and SMS delivery routes. Experience coordinating with promotional, offers, or rewards teams where customer communications involve monetary incentives. Working knowledge of SQL for advanced audience analysis, segmentation, and campaign performance reporting. Key competencies: Detail-oriented: Maintains accuracy across campaign content, audience selection, scheduling, and execution. Execution-focused: Comfortable planning, building, testing, and launching campaigns regularly while following established quality checks. Data-driven: Uses customer behaviour, campaign metrics, and performance trends to identify opportunities and improve results. Customer-centric: Understands user preferences and communication fatigue, ensuring messages are relevant, personalised, and appropriately timed. Proactive and accountable: Takes ownership of campaign outcomes, identifies potential issues early, and continuously seeks improvements. Collaborative: Works effectively across teams to align customer communications with product and business priorities. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Annual salary ranging from INR 5 LPA to INR 10 LPA (₹500,000–₹1,000,000). Fully remote work: Opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in India. Full-time opportunity: Stable, full-time professional engagement. Career development: Opportunity to grow from hands-on campaign execution into broader lifecycle marketing strategy and ownership. Practical CRM experience: Work with leading customer engagement and marketing automation platforms, including MoEngage, CleverTap, Braze, and WebEngage. Cross-functional exposure: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, LiveOps, and promotional teams. Measurable business impact: Directly contribute to customer activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and reactivation. Professional growth: Develop expertise in CRM operations, customer segmentation, lifecycle automation, experimentation, and data-driven marketing.
